services.title: Hospitality Design
services.description: Arrival, stay, and memory, held in one atmosphere.
services.detail: Hotels, lounges, and reception environments where the first impression becomes the lasting one — light, material, and circulation composed for guests who arrive tired and leave remembered.

services.title: Residential Design
services.description: Homes that feel like the people who live in them.
services.detail: Apartments, villas, and family homes shaped around daily ritual — how you cook, gather, rest, and host — so the interior reads as yours, not a catalogue.

services.title: Corporate Design
services.description: Workplaces with identity, not just desks.
services.detail: Offices and meeting environments tuned for focus, collaboration, and brand presence — from reception to boardroom, every room supports how your team actually works.

services.title: Restaurant Design
services.description: Rooms that taste like the kitchen's intent.
services.detail: Cafés, restaurants, and dining rooms where atmosphere supports the menu — seating rhythm, lighting layers, and material warmth that make every table feel considered.

services.title: Commercial Design
services.description: Retail and business space that invites and converts.
services.detail: Showrooms, retail floors, and commercial interiors that balance display with dwell time — spaces that invite people in and keep them engaged.

services.title: Industrial Design
services.description: Clear, durable rooms where process can breathe.
services.detail: Workshops, studios, and functional interiors where clarity of layout and honest materials support the work happening inside them.
